# gigahost_operating_systems (Data Source)

Lists the operating systems available for server deploy and in-place reinstall as one flat list. Use the `slug` values for `gigahost_server.os`. Same data as `gigahost deploy os`. For picking exactly one OS, prefer `gigahost_operating_system`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every installable operating system as one flat list.
data "gigahost_operating_systems" "all" {}

# Narrow to one distribution; entries carry the slug for gigahost_server.os.
data "gigahost_operating_systems" "debian" {
  distribution = "debian"
}

output "debian_slugs" {
  value = data.gigahost_operating_systems.debian.operating_systems[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `distribution` (String) Only OSes of distributions whose name contains this string (case-insensitive), e.g. `"debian"`.

### Read-Only

- `operating_systems` (Attributes List) Installable operating systems. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operating_systems))

<a id="nestedatt--operating_systems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operating_systems`

Read-Only:

- `arch` (String)
- `codename` (String)
- `dedicated_only` (Boolean) Only installable on dedicated servers.
- `distribution` (String) Parent distribution, e.g. `debian`.
- `min_ram_gb` (Number) Minimum RAM required, in GB.
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String) OS slug for `gigahost_server.os`, e.g. `debian-12`.
